title: pkix-ac Error missing serde and Send+Sync assertion
description:
pkix-ac::Error derives `Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq` but has no `serde` Cargo feature and no `#[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", derive(...))]`. It also lacks the Send + Sync compile-time assertion present in all substantive sibling crates (pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-chain, pkix-aia, pkix-truststore, pkix-lint, pkix-zlint-bridge).

pkix-ac has a `std` feature that propagates to pkix-path/std, indicating it is not a bare stub — it has enough structure to warrant the same error-type discipline as its siblings.

AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6: 'Public result/error types ... MUST derive Clone + Debug + PartialEq + Eq and MUST be Send + Sync. They SHOULD support serde::Serialize + Deserialize behind a serde feature flag.'

pkix-ac satisfies the MUST but not the SHOULD (serde) and lacks the MUST (Send+Sync) compile-time assertion that every other crate uses to pin the guarantee.

Location: /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-ac/src/lib.rs line 78-80, /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-ac/Cargo.toml
